open.description:
The tab the popup opens on. "auto": the timers when one has finished and you have not looked, or when you were there last and one is in
progress; else the calendar. "last": the one you were on. A timer that finished unseen always wins.
"auto" | "calendar" | "timers" | "last".

Takes "auto", "calendar", "timers" or "last". Default: "auto".

seconds.description:
The seconds beside the bar's time: "hover" (while the pointer is on the clock) | "always" | "never".

Takes "hover", "always" or "never". Default: "hover".

snoozeMin.description:
What Snooze adds, in minutes. 1 .. 120.

Takes a number 1 .. 120. Default: 9.

sounds.description:
The sound of each: a file name of /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo, a path (~ is your home), or "none". A file that is not there is
the one written here.

volume.description:
How loud, 0 .. 1; -1 plays it at the level of the sound server's stream.

Takes a number -1 .. 1. Default: -1.

ringSec.description:
A countdown or an alarm rings for this many seconds at most. 1 .. 3600.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 3600. Default: 60.

soundUnderDnd.description:
They sound while do-not-disturb is on. true | false (the card is shown either way).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

countdownMin.description:
The countdown's first time in a session, minutes. Read as the shell starts.

Takes a number 0.1 .. 1440. Default: 5. Read as the shell starts.

focusMin.description:
The pomodoro's focus, short break and long break, minutes: where they start, and what a right click on one puts back.

Takes a number 1 .. 240. Default: 25. Read as the shell starts.

shortMin.description: Takes a number 1 .. 120. Default: 5. Read as the shell starts.

longMin.description: Takes a number 1 .. 240. Default: 30. Read as the shell starts.

missedHours.description:
An alarm missed by more than this many hours (the machine was off) is not reported. 0 .. 168.

Takes a number 0 .. 168. Default: 12.

look.description: Where the wiki's card opens beside the popup: "end" (the right of a top bar's popup) | "start" (the left) | "far" (below it).
